text:
Predicates:
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Settlement(x) ::: x is a settlement.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
Archipelago(x) ::: x is an archipelago.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is Antarctica.
Place(x) ::: x is a place.
Barutin(x) ::: x is Barutin.
BarutinCove(x) ::: x is Barutin Cove.
Southwest(x) ::: x is southwest.
SnowIsland(x) ::: x is Snow Island.
GreenwichIsland(x) ::: x is Greenwich Island.
DeceptionIsland(x) ::: x is Deception Island.
SouthShetlandIslands(x) ::: x is the South Shetland Islands.
Premises:
Cove(barutinCove) ∧ NamedAfter(barutinCove, barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is a cove named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
LocatedIn(barutinCove, southwest) ∧ LocatedIn(southwest, snowIsland) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
LocatedIn(snowIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ LocatedIn(greenwichIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ LocatedIn(deceptionIsland, southShetlandIslands) ::: Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island are located in the South Shetland Islands.
LocatedIn(southShetlandIslands, antarctica) ::: Antarctica is located on the South Shetland Islands.
∀x ∀y ∀z (LocatedIn(x, y) ∧ LocatedIn(y, z) → LocatedIn(x, z)) ::: If place A is located in place B and place B is located in place C, then place A is located in place C.
Conclusion:
¬LocatedIn(barutinCove, antarctica) ::: Barutin Cove is not located in Antarctica.
